description: This class manages sensor values and listeners, providing methods to get/set sensor data, add/remove listeners, initialize sensors, and handle sensor updates within the system.

classes.name: SensorCentral
classes.description: Manages sensor values and listeners, providing sensor data access and update mechanisms.

classes.name: SensorCentral.SensorListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified of sensor value updates.

classes.name: SensorCentral.SensorListener2
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified of sensor updates with sensor info.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SensorCentral.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a specified sensor and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for updates from any sensor.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from a specific sensor.

methods.name: getValueSource
methods.description: Provides a ValueSource functional interface for a sensor.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes sensors with engine state data.

methods.name: applyValueToTables
methods.description: Applies sensor value updates to relevant tables and listeners.

methods.name: addDoubleSensor
methods.description: Helper methods to add sensors with specific keys or enum names.
